title: Remove stale metrics no longer emitted from the metrics registry
body:
Remove the three orphaned entries from `metrics_template.yaml`:

- `dag_processing.manager_stalls` — emission removed in #45729
- `dag_file_refresh_error` — emission removed in #44972
- `collect_db_dags` — emission removed in #53918
